subtitle: A weekly planner where your AI moves unfinished tasks along.
about: A note with your top three, a checklist for each day and a list for later. Tell your AI what's on to plan the week, or ask it to move unfinished tasks to today.

ask.prompt: Set up the weekly planner template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Plan the week
slides.you: Plan next week: parcel Monday, budget by Tuesday, dentist Wednesday at 9, flights, three runs. Top three: budget, flights, runs.
slides.ai: Planned it. Flights and runs have no day, so they go in Later.
slides.alt: Next week planned day by day, with the top three

slides.label: Midweek, move a task
slides.you: It's Wednesday. I did everything on Monday and Tuesday except the parcel. Move it to today.
slides.ai: Moved Return the parcel to Wednesday and ticked off the budget.
slides.alt: The parcel moved to Wednesday, the budget ticked

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
slides.alt: Weekly planner as it starts, ready to fill in
